name: 金庸群侠传（2008 标准版）
english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Standard Edition)
english_description: The base "2008" release of this project's 金庸群侠传/"Jin Yong Heroes Gathering" (ES II engine) family -- a full raw-archive diff against sibling jqxz2008 ("Enhanced") turned up only 22 differing files out of 3,772, none engine-relevant (shorter room text and fewer quest-list entries, consistent with the Enhanced edition's own branding). Same tea-house start, Beggars'-Sect passphrase-hideout join under 左全/Zuo Quan, and White Camel Mount recruiter path as its siblings. A genuinely interesting find: this plainer "Standard" build's own copies of the shared engine's most severe bugs (a corrupted-save crash in Chinese-text translation, a missing-directory crash on every player death, a misplaced-parenthesis sect-defection check) were ALREADY written correctly here -- they turn out to be regressions introduced when the Enhanced/Deluxe editions later modified this same base, not defects in the original. This build did carry its own severe bug, independently found and fixed: a shared tell_room() call with a missing argument silently crashed and disabled the entire net-dead force-quit safety net, meaning a disconnected player's progress would never actually get saved. Full deep testing (organic sect apprenticeship, real combat death and reincarnation, a completed shop purchase) all verified live end to end -- see NOTES.md.
